items.label: Foldline: post today's puzzle now
items.description: Creates today's puzzle post if it does not exist yet

items.label: Foldline: regenerate today's puzzle
items.description: Replaces today's puzzle and starts a clean leaderboard

items.label: Foldline: skip a day
items.description: Skip today or tomorrow without breaking streaks

items.label: Foldline: post a specific day
items.description: Backfill a missed day or post an upcoming one early

startDate.label: Start date (Day 1)
startDate.helpText: The date of Day 1, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use the date the app was installed.

timezone.label: Release timezone
timezone.helpText: IANA timezone name, for example UTC or America/Los_Angeles. A day's puzzle is released at midnight in this zone. Puzzle content never depends on it.

communityRoutes.label: Community Routes
communityRoutes.helpText: Let players build puzzles. The week's top-upvoted valid route becomes Sunday's puzzle.

streakFlair.label: Streak flair
streakFlair.helpText: Let players opt in to a user flair for their best streak: Crease (3 days), Pleat (7), Origami (30).
